The MTCP Scholarship is sponsored by the Malaysian Government and dedicated to international students from developing countries to pursue their postgraduate studies in Malaysia, whilst at the same time acquire the necessary knowledge and skills that could contribute to the development of their country.

MTCP Scholarship Abstract

  • Scholarship Host: MALAYSIAN TECHNICAL COOPERATION PROGRAMME (MTCP)

  • Location: Malaysian

  • Category: Scholarships || Master's Scholarship

  • Benefits: Full Scholarship

    • This Scholarship covers tuition fees and other allowances.

    • Return economy-class airline ticket.

  • Eligibility: Developing Countries

  • Deadline: 12 June 2026.

MTCP Scholarship Details

The Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) Scholarship 2026 has officially opened applications for international students from developing countries who wish to pursue a fully funded Master’s degree in Malaysia. Funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Malaysia, the scholarship aims to support talented graduates in fields related to technology, sustainable development, public policy, economics, and science. The duration of the award is between 24 to 36 months for Master's Degree Programme covering any mode of study (Coursework, Mixed Mode and Research).

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Applicants must comply with the following criteria:

  1. Not more than 45 years old at the time of application;

  2. Obtain a minimum of Second Class Upper (Honours) or a minimum CGPA of 3.0 or equivalent at the Undergraduate level;

  3. Provide proof of English Language Proficiency: Scanned copy of the original proof of English Language Proficiency such as IELTS (minimum total score or TOEFL internet-based test (minimum total score of 60); or Has obtained a previous degree(s) with English used as the medium of instruction.

  4. Excellent level of health certified by a doctor/ physician. The cost of the medical check-up shall be fully borne by the applicant. Medical report form can be downloaded from the MTCP Scholarship website. The Medical Report must be valid within six (6) months from the date of application.

APPLICATION PROCESS

  • Interested applicants are required to register and apply for MTCP Scholarship through the system at https://mtcp.kln.gov.my/register_scholarship.

  • The system utilised for registration shall also be used for the entire application and selection procedure. Applicants may be required to log in to the system at different stages of the process to obtain updates on the status of their application or to provide supplementary documents.

Note: Only applications that have been submitted into the system will be considered. Applications that are found to contain inaccurate or falsified information may be subject to disqualification.

Required Documents

  1. Copy of Passport Information Page as evidence of nationality (minimum of 12 months validity).

  2. Copy of Academic Transcript

  3. Proof of English Language Proficiency test

  4. Curriculum Vitae

  5. Medical Report (can be downloaded from the MTCP scholarship website).

  6. Letter of Recommendation from two (2) referees (can be downloaded from the MTCP Scholarship website).

  7. Valid Full Offer Letter from Malaysian Universities for academic intake September/October

SCHOLARSHIP BENEFITS

a) Tuition fees for the whole sponsorship period will be paid directly to the university upon issuance of invoice by the university;

b) Monthly allowance will be paid directly to your Malaysian bank account; and

c) A one-time economy class flight ticket from the student’s closest international airport to Malaysia for the start of the scholarship programme and a return ticket to the student’s home country upon the completion of the scholarship programme.

AREAS OF STUDY

Priority will be given to the following areas of study:

i. Information and Communication Technology;

ii. Economy and Trade;

iii. Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM); i

v. Food Security and Agriculture Technology;

v. Islamic Finance;

vi. Law;

vii. Public Administration and Policy Studies; and

viii. Sustainable and Environmental Science.

Not applicable for Nursing, Medicine & Clinical Pharmacy courses
